tools.name: inventorynow_list_items
tools.description: List inventory items, newest change first, with stock on hand (bought − sold − loss), prices, custom fields and barcodes. Filter by search text, category, location or stock status. Inventory Now API: GET /items.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_item
tools.description: Get one item by id, with its photos, its expenses and profit figures (true_profit, true_margin). Inventory Now API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_items_summary
tools.description: Quick checksum of the whole inventory: sum, count, bought_sum and sold_sum (deleted items excluded). This is not a stock value or profit report. Inventory Now API: GET /items/summary.

tools.name: inventorynow_list_orders
tools.description: List buy (supplier purchase) and sell (customer sale) orders, newest first, 100 per page, cancelled orders excluded. Use updated_since to see changes, including cancellations. Inventory Now API: GET /orders.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its lines, items, expenses and expense-aware profit. Inventory Now API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_settings
tools.description: Get the account's settings: currency symbol, the labels for category, location and custom fields, the low-stock default and which order status steps are on. Inventory Now API: GET /user_settings.

tools.name: inventorynow_create_item
tools.description: Create an inventory item. Starts at zero stock: add stock with inventorynow_create_order (buy). If an item with the same internal_id already exists it is updated instead, so a stable internal_id makes a retry safe. Inventory Now API: POST /items.

tools.name: inventorynow_update_item
tools.description: Update an item. Only the fields you send change. Stock counts are not changed here: use inventorynow_create_order. Inventory Now API: PUT /items/{id}.

tools.name: inventorynow_create_order
tools.description: Record a purchase (buy, adds stock) or a sale (sell, removes stock) with one or more lines. A sale of more units than are on hand fails unless back orders are on. Set adjust_stock to false to record the order without moving stock. Inventory Now API: POST /orders.

tools.name: inventorynow_complete_order
tools.description: Mark an order completed and paid. If the account uses order status steps, completing also moves them. Inventory Now API: PUT /orders/{id}/complete.

tools.name: inventorynow_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order and put its stock back: the counts the order moved are reversed. The order stays on record as cancelled. Inventory Now API: PUT /orders/{id}/cancel.
